local Tablify = require("tablify/tablify")
local Commands = 
{
	["NORMAL"] = function(Input)
		if #Input % 2 == 1 then
			return " > Failed, wrong number of arguments
"
		end
		table.remove(Input, 1)
		local File = io.open(Input[1], "r")
		local Data = File:read("*all")
		File:close()
		for i = 2, #Input, 2 do
			Data = Data:gsub(Input[i], Input[i+1])
		end
		local OutputFile = io.open("output.txt", "w")
		OutputFile:write(Data)
		OutputFile:close()
		return " > Complete
"
	end
}
repeat
	io.write(" < ")
	local Input = Tablify.Execute("NORMAL", io.read("*line"), " ")
	Input[1] = Input[1]:upper()
	if Commands[Input[1]] then
		local Result = Commands[Input[1]](Input)
		io.write(Result)
	end
until Input[1] == "EXIT"

end
